answer.reason: For Wyoming statewide in BLS QCEW fourth-quarter 2024, the private-sector covered employment level for NAICS 54 (Professional, scientific, and technical services) is consistent with roughly 11,000 jobs, not roughly 23,000. Therefore 11,312 covered jobs is the supported choice.

metadata.prompt:
Question: In the BLS QCEW fourth-quarter 2024 data for Wyoming, what was the December 2024 private-sector employment level, in covered jobs, for NAICS 54 Professional, scientific, and technical services?

A. 23,387 covered jobs
B. 11,312 covered jobs

Source citation: BLS QCEW Open Data, Wyoming statewide, 2024 Q4 (https://data.bls.gov/cew/data/api/2024/4/area/56000.csv)
